name: rpi-usage
description: Usage lookup: /usage queries the current model provider's typed balance, plan quota or subscription windows through the host scripted usage-provider framework — built-in DeepSeek, GLM Coding Plan, MiniMax Token Plan, Kimi Code, OpenCode Go, Anthropic, OpenAI Codex and xAI scripts — and keeps a typed footer status line; --cached/--json/--provider and /usage list/help are supported, providers without quota show local session tokens only, and custom providers drop in as user scripts.
author: revpidev
descriptionZh: 用量查询:/usage 经宿主脚本化 usage-provider 框架查询当前接入 provider 的类型化余额/套餐配额/订阅窗口(内置 DeepSeek/GLM Coding Plan/MiniMax Token Plan/Kimi Code/OpenCode Go/Anthropic/OpenAI Codex/xAI 八家脚本),footer 自动展示类型化状态行;支持 --cached/--json/--provider 与 /usage list/help,无配额 provider 只显示当前会话本地 token,用户脚本可扩展自定义 provider。
